name: Historic Centre of Salvador
name_zh: 萨尔瓦多 · 历史中心
note: 1832 年 2 月，小猎犬号停靠巴伊亚的萨尔瓦多，二十三岁的达尔文第一次独自走进热带森林，激动得说“喜悦”这个词都不够用。萨尔瓦多是巴西的第一座首都，山上老城的彩色殖民建筑和教堂至今完好，整片历史中心是世界遗产
note_en: In February 1832 the Beagle put in at Salvador da Bahia, and twenty-three-year-old Darwin walked alone into a tropical forest for the first time. He was so thrilled that he said 'delight' wasn't a strong enough word. Salvador was Brazil's first capital, and the colorful colonial houses and churches of its hilltop old town are still beautifully preserved. The whole historic center is a World Heritage Site

name: Botafogo Bay and the Corcovado, Rio de Janeiro
name_zh: 里约热内卢 · 博塔福戈湾与科尔科瓦多山
note: 1832 年达尔文在博塔福戈湾边租了一间小屋，就住在科尔科瓦多山脚下，整天在附近的森林里采集标本。半个多世纪后，阿泽维多把他的小说《贫民窟》也放在博塔福戈：一个吝啬的店主在这里盖起大杂院，里面挤满了葡萄牙移民、黑人和混血的穷人。如今科尔科瓦多山顶站着基督像
note_en: In 1832 Darwin rented a cottage on Botafogo Bay, right at the foot of the Corcovado, and spent his days collecting in the nearby forest. More than half a century later, Aluísio Azevedo set his novel The Slum in Botafogo too: a stingy shopkeeper builds a crowded tenement here, packed with Portuguese immigrants and poor Black and mixed-race families. Today the statue of Christ the Redeemer stands on top of the Corcovado

name: Engenho Novo, Rio de Janeiro
name_zh: 里约热内卢 · 新磨坊区
note: 《堂卡斯穆罗》的叙述者本托就住在这个北郊老区。孤独的他在这里照原样复制了自己童年在马塔卡瓦洛斯街的老房子，又坐下来写回忆录，想把青春“两头接起来”。读者至今还在争论，他怀疑妻子卡皮图出轨，到底有没有根据
note_en: Bento, the narrator of Dom Casmurro, lives in this old northern suburb of Rio. Lonely in old age, he builds an exact copy of his childhood home on the Rua de Matacavalos here, then sits down to write his memoir, trying to tie the two ends of his life together. Readers are still arguing over whether he had any real reason to suspect his wife Capitu of betraying him

name: Academia Brasileira de Letras
name_zh: 里约热内卢 · 巴西文学院
note: 巴西文学院 1897 年成立，马沙多·德·阿西斯是首任院长，一直当到 1908 年去世。他是混血的穷孩子出身，靠自学成了巴西最伟大的作家。学院所在的这座小楼仿照凡尔赛的小特里亚农宫，是法国 1923 年赠送的
note_en: The Brazilian Academy of Letters was founded in 1897, and Machado de Assis was its first president, a post he held until his death in 1908. Born poor and of mixed race, he taught himself and became Brazil's greatest writer. The Academy's building is a copy of the Petit Trianon at Versailles, a gift from France in 1923

name: Praia de Iracema, Fortaleza
name_zh: 福塔莱萨 · 伊拉塞玛海滩
note: 《伊拉塞玛》写的是殖民初年一个印第安少女爱上葡萄牙士兵的故事，书名“伊拉塞玛”正好是“美洲”（America）的字母换位。阿伦卡尔是塞阿拉人，小说开篇就是对家乡这片海的呼唤。福塔莱萨后来把这片海滩命名为伊拉塞玛海滩，海边立着她的雕像
note_en: Iracema tells of an Indigenous girl who falls in love with a Portuguese soldier in the early days of the colony, and her name is an anagram of 'America'. Alencar came from Ceará, and the novel opens with a call to the sea of his home coast. Fortaleza later named this beach after her, and her statue stands on the waterfront

name: Ver-o-Peso, Belém
name_zh: 贝伦 · 韦罗佩索市场
note: 1848 年，英国博物学家贝茨和华莱士一起坐船来到帕拉（今天的贝伦），从这里出发深入亚马孙。贝茨在这片流域一待就是十一年，采集了一万四千多种昆虫，后来提出了以他命名的“贝茨拟态”。贝伦港边的韦罗佩索市场从殖民时代起就是河上货物的集散地
note_en: In 1848 the English naturalists Henry Walter Bates and Alfred Russel Wallace sailed into Pará, today's Belém, and set off from here into the Amazon. Bates stayed eleven years and collected more than fourteen thousand species, most of them insects, and later described the kind of mimicry now named after him. The Ver-o-Peso market on the waterfront has been the trading hub for river goods since colonial times

name: River of Doubt (Rio Roosevelt), start of the 1914 expedition
name_zh: 朗多尼亚 · 疑河（罗斯福河）起点
note: 1914 年，卸任总统罗斯福和巴西探险家龙东一起，从这里顺着地图上还是一片空白的“疑河”而下。两个月里他们翻船、断粮、染上疟疾，罗斯福本人差点死在途中，但最终把这条七百多公里长的河画上了地图。巴西随后把它改名为罗斯福河
note_en: In 1914 the former president Theodore Roosevelt and the Brazilian explorer Cândido Rondon set off from here down the River of Doubt, still a blank on the map. Over two months they lost canoes, ran short of food and caught malaria, and Roosevelt himself nearly died, but they put the whole river, some 470 miles long, on the map. Brazil then renamed it the Roosevelt River
coord_checked: Roosevelt gives the camp's position as 12°1′S, 60°15′W in Through the Brazilian Wilderness (Project Gutenberg) — https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11746

name: Fundação Casa de Jorge Amado, Salvador
name_zh: 萨尔瓦多 · 若热·亚马多之家
note: 若热·亚马多是巴西最受欢迎的作家，他的小说几乎都写巴伊亚：可可庄园、码头、佩洛林尼奥区的街巷。这座位于老城佩洛林尼奥广场边的蓝色楼房 1987 年起成为他的基金会和纪念馆，藏着他的手稿、照片和各种译本
note_en: Jorge Amado is Brazil's best-loved novelist, and nearly all his books are set in Bahia: its cocoa plantations, its docks and the lanes of the Pelourinho. Since 1987 this blue building on the Pelourinho square in the old town has been his foundation and museum, with his manuscripts, photographs and translations of his work
coord_checked: Fundação Casa de Jorge Amado (Wikimedia Commons) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Fundação_Casa_de_Jorge_Amado

name: Bar Vesúvio, Ilhéus
name_zh: 伊列乌斯 · 维苏威酒吧
note: 《加布里埃拉》的故事就围绕这家酒吧展开：1925 年可可热潮中的伊列乌斯，叙利亚裔老板纳西布雇来一个从旱区逃荒来的姑娘做厨娘，她的菜和她本人很快让全城着迷。真实的维苏威酒吧至今还在大教堂对面营业，门口坐着亚马多的铜像
note_en: Gabriela is built around this bar. In Ilhéus during the cocoa boom of 1925, its Syrian-born owner, Nacib, hires a girl who has fled the drought in the backlands as his cook, and both her cooking and Gabriela herself soon have the whole town spellbound. The real Bar Vesúvio is still open across from the cathedral, with a bronze of Jorge Amado sitting outside

name: Museu Casa Guimarães Rosa, Cordisburgo
name_zh: 科迪斯堡 · 吉马良斯·罗萨故居博物馆
note: 吉马良斯·罗萨 1908 年出生在这座米纳斯吉拉斯小镇，童年就在父亲的杂货铺里听赶牛人讲故事。这些腹地的口音和传说后来都写进了《广阔的腹地：条条小路》，常被认为是巴西二十世纪最伟大的小说。他家的老房子和店铺现在是纪念馆，镇上的少年讲解员会背诵他的段落
note_en: Guimarães Rosa was born in this small Minas Gerais town in 1908 and grew up listening to cattle drivers tell stories in his father's general store. The voices and legends of the backlands went into The Devil to Pay in the Backlands, often called the greatest Brazilian novel of the twentieth century. The family house and store are now a museum, where local teenagers act as guides and recite passages from his work

name: Casa Museu Graciliano Ramos, Palmeira dos Índios
name_zh: 帕尔梅拉-多斯因迪奥斯 · 格拉西利亚诺·拉莫斯故居
note: 格拉西利亚诺·拉莫斯 1928 年当选这座阿拉戈斯小城的市长，他写给州长的两份工作报告文笔犀利，在报上一登就让他出了名，从此走上写作之路。他后来的《干枯的生命》写一家人在大旱中流浪，是巴西东北腹地文学的代表作。他住过的房子现为纪念馆
note_en: Graciliano Ramos was elected mayor of this small town in Alagoas in 1928, and the two reports he wrote to the governor were so sharp that, once printed in the papers, they launched his career as a writer. His later novel Barren Lives, about a family wandering through a great drought, is the classic book of Brazil's northeastern backlands. His house is now a museum

name: Parque Estadual de Canudos
name_zh: 卡努杜斯州立公园
note: 1890 年代，传教士“劝世者”安东尼奥在巴伊亚腹地建起卡努杜斯村，几万名穷苦的追随者聚到这里。共和国政府视之为叛乱，派兵四次征讨，1897 年把村子夷为平地。巴尔加斯·略萨根据这段历史写成《世界末日之战》。原来的村址后来被水库淹没，州立公园保存着当年的战场
note_en: In the 1890s the preacher Antônio Conselheiro founded the settlement of Canudos in the Bahian backlands, and tens of thousands of poor followers gathered around him. The new republic saw it as a rebellion, sent four military expeditions against it and razed it to the ground in 1897. Mario Vargas Llosa told the story in The War of the End of the World. The original village now lies under a reservoir, and the state park preserves the old battlefields

name: Casa Mário de Andrade, São Paulo
name_zh: 圣保罗 · 马里奥·德·安德拉德之家
note: 巴西现代主义的领袖马里奥·德·安德拉德从 1921 年起住在巴拉丰达区洛佩斯·沙维斯街的这座房子里，直到 1945 年去世。他在这里写成了《马库纳伊玛》：一个“没有任何品格”的亚马孙英雄，从丛林一路闯进圣保罗，被看作巴西人身份的寓言。房子现在是州立的写作之家，常年办文学活动
note_en: Mário de Andrade, the leader of Brazilian modernism, lived in this house on Rua Lopes Chaves in Barra Funda from 1921 until his death in 1945. Here he wrote Macunaíma, about an Amazonian 'hero without any character' who makes his way from the jungle to São Paulo, a book often read as a fable of Brazilian identity. The house is now a state-run writers' house with a busy program of literary events

name: Statue of Clarice Lispector, Leme
name_zh: 里约热内卢 · 莱米海滩的克拉丽丝雕像
note: 克拉丽丝·李斯佩克朵晚年住在莱米，常带着她的狗在这片海边散步。她的最后一部小说《星辰时刻》写一个从东北来到里约、几乎被城市忽视的打字员姑娘。2016 年，这里立起了她和爱犬乌利塞斯的铜像
note_en: Clarice Lispector spent her later years in Leme and often walked her dog along this stretch of beach. Her last novel, The Hour of the Star, follows a young typist from the northeast whom the big city barely notices. In 2016 a bronze of Clarice and her dog Ulisses was unveiled here
coord_checked: Statue of Clarice Lispector (Rio de Janeiro) (Wikimedia Commons) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Statue_of_Clarice_Lispector_(Rio_de_Janeiro)

name: Cidade de Deus, Rio de Janeiro
name_zh: 里约热内卢 · 上帝之城
note: 上世纪 60 年代，里约政府把市中心贫民窟的居民迁到西郊新建的这片住宅区，取名“上帝之城”。保罗·林斯在这里长大，1997 年出版的同名小说用几十年间的帮派争斗写出了这里的暴力与日常，2002 年改编的电影让它闻名世界。这里至今仍是有人居住的普通社区，不是景点，想去最好跟社区里的当地导览
note_en: In the 1960s Rio's government moved families from favelas in the center out to this new housing project on the western edge of the city and called it City of God. Paulo Lins grew up here, and his 1997 novel of the same name follows decades of gang wars to show the violence and the everyday life of the place; the 2002 film made it famous around the world. It is still an ordinary neighborhood where people live, not a tourist site, so if you go, go with a local community guide

name: Maceió
name_zh: 马塞约
note: 《焦虑》的主人公路易斯是马塞约一个穷困的小公务员，在嫉妒和屈辱里一步步走向杀人，全书几乎都是他混乱的内心独白。拉莫斯三十年代在马塞约主管全州教育，书稿付印时他正因政治原因身陷囹圄。马塞约是阿拉戈斯州首府，海水碧绿
note_en: Luís, the hero of Anguish, is a poor minor civil servant in Maceió, pushed step by step toward murder by jealousy and humiliation, and almost the whole book is his tangled inner voice. Graciliano Ramos ran the state's schools from Maceió in the 1930s, and when the book went to press he was in prison for his politics. Maceió is the capital of Alagoas, known for its green sea

name: Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro
name_zh: 里约热内卢植物园
note: 李斯佩克朵最有名的短篇《爱》里，家庭主妇安娜在电车上看见一个嚼口香糖的盲人，心神大乱，坐过了站，误入植物园，在暮色里的花木间第一次感到生命的狂野。植物园是 1808 年葡萄牙摄政王若昂下令建的，帝王椰子大道最有名
note_en: In Clarice Lispector's best-known story, 'Love', the housewife Ana sees a blind man chewing gum from the tram, is so shaken that she misses her stop, and wanders into the Botanical Garden, where among the plants at dusk she feels the wildness of life for the first time. The garden was founded in 1808 by the Portuguese prince regent, Dom João, and is famous for its avenue of royal palms
coord_checked: Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro (Wikimedia Commons) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Jardim_Botânico_do_Rio_de_Janeiro

name: Quixadá
name_zh: 基沙达
note: 1915 年塞阿拉大旱，《一五年》里的放牛人希科·本托一家从基沙达徒步逃荒，路上饿死了孩子，最后流落到福塔莱萨的灾民营。拉谢尔·德·克罗斯家的庄园就在基沙达，她十九岁写成这部小说，后来成了巴西文学院第一位女院士。基沙达以平原上拔地而起的巨石闻名
note_en: In the great drought of 1915 in Ceará, the cowhand Chico Bento and his family in The Year Fifteen set out on foot from Quixadá, lose a child to hunger on the road, and end up in a refugee camp in Fortaleza. Rachel de Queiroz's family had a farm at Quixadá; she wrote the novel at nineteen and later became the first woman in the Brazilian Academy of Letters. Quixadá is known for the giant rocks that rise out of its plain

name: Museu Érico Veríssimo, Cruz Alta
name_zh: 克鲁斯阿尔塔 · 埃里科·韦里西莫博物馆
note: 韦里西莫 1905 年生在南里奥格兰德州高原上的克鲁斯阿尔塔，这座老房子如今是他的纪念馆。他的三部曲《时间与风》写虚构的圣菲镇两百年间几代人的恩怨，人们常说圣菲的原型就是这座小城；《安塔雷斯事件》里一场罢工让七个死人下不了葬，便起身进城清算活人
note_en: Erico Verissimo was born in 1905 in Cruz Alta, on the highlands of Rio Grande do Sul, and this old house is now his museum. His trilogy Time and the Wind follows generations of feuding families over two hundred years in the invented town of Santa Fé, often said to be modelled on Cruz Alta; in Incident in Antares a strike leaves seven corpses unburied, and they rise and walk into town to settle accounts with the living

name: Canindé, São Paulo
name_zh: 圣保罗 · 卡宁德
note: 卡罗利娜·玛利亚·德·热苏斯在铁特河边的卡宁德贫民窟捡废纸养活三个孩子，把日记写在捡来的本子上。记者奥达利奥·当塔斯 1958 年来采访时发现了它，1960 年出版成了畅销书，译成十几种语言。贫民窟早已拆除，原址一带如今是葡萄牙人体育会的球场
note_en: Carolina Maria de Jesus raised three children by collecting scrap paper in the Canindé favela on the banks of the Tietê, and wrote her diary in notebooks she found in the rubbish. The journalist Audálio Dantas discovered it on a visit in 1958; published in 1960, it became a bestseller and was translated into more than a dozen languages. The favela was cleared long ago, and the area is now home to Portuguesa's football stadium

name: Taperoá, Paraíba
name_zh: 帕拉伊巴 · 塔佩罗阿
note: 《慈悲圣母的审判》就发生在帕拉伊巴腹地的塔佩罗阿：穷光蛋若昂·格里洛和朋友奇科靠小聪明骗过神父、主教和强盗，死后受审，靠圣母说情得救。苏阿苏纳童年在这座小镇度过，剧中人物说的都是这里的方言。2000 年改编的电影在巴西家喻户晓
note_en: A Dog as a Gift is set in Taperoá, in the backlands of Paraíba: the penniless João Grilo and his friend Chicó trick a priest, a bishop and a bandit, then face judgment after death and are saved when the Virgin Mary speaks up for them. Ariano Suassuna spent his childhood in this small town, and his characters speak its dialect. The 2000 film version is known to every Brazilian

name: Itaparica
name_zh: 伊塔帕里卡岛
note: 《巴西人民万岁》从十七世纪写到 1977 年，主角是伊塔帕里卡岛上的奴隶、渔民和他们的后代，把整部巴西史写成一部人民的史诗。若昂·乌巴尔多·里贝罗就生在这座岛上。岛在萨尔瓦多对面的万圣湾里，坐渡轮一小时左右，老城里还有殖民时期的房子
note_en: An Invincible Memory runs from the seventeenth century to 1977 and follows the slaves, fishermen and their descendants on the island of Itaparica, turning the whole history of Brazil into an epic of its people. João Ubaldo Ribeiro was born on the island. It lies in the Bay of All Saints across from Salvador, about an hour by ferry, and its old town still has colonial houses

name: Faculdade de Direito, Largo de São Francisco
name_zh: 圣保罗 · 圣弗朗西斯科广场法学院
note: 法贡德斯·特莱斯四十年代在这所法学院读书，是当时少数几个女学生之一。《姑娘们》写军政府最黑暗的年月里，修女办的女生宿舍中三个女大学生：一个富家女、一个左翼学生、一个吸毒的模特。学院在圣保罗老城的圣弗朗西斯科广场，是巴西最古老的法学院之一
note_en: Lygia Fagundes Telles studied at this law school in the 1940s, one of only a few women students at the time. The Girl in the Photograph follows three students in a nuns' boarding house in the darkest years of the military regime: a rich girl, a left-wing activist and a model on drugs. The school, on Largo de São Francisco in old São Paulo, is one of the oldest law schools in Brazil
coord_checked: Faculdade de Direito da Universidade de São Paulo (Wikimedia Commons) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Faculdade_de_Direito_da_Universidade_de_São_Paulo

name: Port of Manaus
name_zh: 马瑙斯港
note: 《两兄弟》里黎巴嫩移民一家住在马瑙斯港口附近，双胞胎雅库布和奥马尔为了母亲的偏爱和同一个女孩反目一生，讲故事的是家中女佣的儿子。哈通生在马瑙斯，书里满是港口的浮动码头、市场和橡胶繁荣过后衰败的城市。港口的浮动码头随河水涨落
note_en: In The Brothers a Lebanese immigrant family lives near the port of Manaus, and the twins Yaqub and Omar are set against each other for life by their mother's favoritism and by the same girl; the story is told by the son of the family's maid. Milton Hatoum was born in Manaus, and the book is full of the port's floating docks, its markets and the city in decline after the rubber boom. The floating dock still rises and falls with the river

name: Chapada Diamantina
name_zh: 迪亚曼蒂纳高原
note: 《弯曲的犁》开篇，两个小姐妹偷拿外婆皮箱里的一把刀，一个人的舌头被割掉了，此后两人用一个声音说话。她们生长在迪亚曼蒂纳高原的“黑水”庄园，祖辈是废奴后留下来替地主干活、没有土地的佃农。高原如今是国家公园，有桌山、瀑布和溶洞
note_en: Crooked Plow opens with two little sisters taking a knife from their grandmother's suitcase; one of them loses her tongue, and from then on the two speak with one voice. They grow up on the Água Negra farm in the Chapada Diamantina, descendants of freed slaves who stayed on to work landowners' fields without any land of their own. The highlands are now a national park of table mountains, waterfalls and caves

name: Porto Alegre
name_zh: 阿雷格里港
note: 《皮肤的反面》里，儿子佩德罗回到阿雷格里港，追寻父亲恩里克的一生：一个在公立学校教文学的黑人老师，在一次警察盘查中被枪杀。小说写尽了巴西黑人日常的种族歧视，2021 年获雅布提奖，后来在几个州被下令撤出学校，又引来全国声援
note_en: In The Dark Side of the Skin, Pedro goes back over the life of his father, Henrique, a Black literature teacher in Porto Alegre's public schools who was shot dead during a police stop. The novel lays bare the everyday racism Black Brazilians face; it won the Jabuti Prize in 2021, and when several states later ordered it out of schools, readers across the country rallied to it

name: Bangu, Rio de Janeiro
name_zh: 里约热内卢 · 邦古
note: 《我亲爱的甜橙树》里五岁的泽泽住在里约北郊的邦古，家里穷，他把后院一棵小甜橙树当成最好的朋友；后来善待他的葡萄牙老人被火车撞死，泽泽一下子长大了。瓦斯康塞洛斯就在邦古度过童年，这本半自传小说在巴西和中国都是几代人的读物
note_en: In My Sweet Orange Tree, five-year-old Zezé lives in poor Bangu on the outskirts of Rio and makes a little orange tree in the backyard his best friend; when the kind old Portuguese man who looks after him is killed by a train, Zezé suddenly grows up. José Mauro de Vasconcelos spent his own childhood in Bangu, and this semi-autobiographical novel has been read by generations in Brazil and in China
